note: Republic Bank's St Vincent Republic Mastercard page, its rates and fees table (in effect as of September 1, 2021), read in full: the Republic Bank Mastercard, Mastercard Gold and AAdvantage Mastercard, all fees in Eastern Caribbean dollars, each with its annual membership fee for the primary card, 22% a year on purchases and balance transfers (the bank says the rate is set on approval and could be 22%, the only figure it gives), a minimum payment of 2.77% of the principal balance plus the period's interest (the 'any other fees' it also adds aren't modelled), a cash advance fee of 3.2% with a floor, the late payment, returned cheque and over limit charges, and an interest-free period of at least 50 days on purchases when the statement is paid in full (written as 50). The replacement card and statement charges aren't written. The page states no foreign transaction fee or penalty rate.

sources.title: Republic Bank, Republic Mastercard: Rates and Fees (St Vincent; in effect as of September 1, 2021)
sources.said: Your Republic Bank credit cards are subject to certain rates and fees. Information on those charges, which are subject to change, is set out below. All fees are in XCD. ... Annual Interest Rate (Financing Charges) Purchases and Balance Transfers 22% 22% 22% ... Annual Membership Fees – Primary Card $85.00 $190.00 $75.00 ... Minimum Payment 2.77% of the principal balance plus interest calculated for the period plus any other fees. ... Cash Advance – In Branch / ATM** 3.2% of total cash Advance; minimum $15.00 ... Late payment charge $75.00 $75.00 $75.00 Dishonored / Returned Cheques $45.00 $45.00 $45.00 ... Over Limit Charge (Flat Charge Per Each Overrun) $75.00 $75.00 $75.00 ... Rates and fees in effect as of September 1, 2021 and are subject to change. ... You will benefit from an interest-free period of at least 50 days for new purchases and fees if you pay your statement balance in full by the payment due date shown on your statement.
